counterfactual.change: Reduced vx from 45 to 10 m/s (single field change); lower per-step displacement allows collision solver to prevent penetration, so violation disappears.

explanation: Thin wall (h=0.28) with high-speed body vx=45 m/s. With dt=0.003 and 5 substeps, per-substep displacement ~0.027m, body arrives at left face at step 16-17 then penetrates deeply by step 18. Collision impulse/positional correction insufficient to prevent overlap beyond 0.15 tolerance. Reducing speed prevents tunneling/penetration, indicating CCD/discrete collision handling fails at high velocity vs thin geometry.
vision_note: The red violating body sits at the left tip of the thin horizontal grey wall from step 15 through 18. By step 18 it appears embedded overlapping the wall end instead of bouncing or stopping at the face.
